summary: Defines a TOP input connector inside a Component, with optional label text and Common TOP output controls.

key_params.name: label
key_params.note: Hover/help label for the component input

common_gotchas: Operator name and order matter more than Label for connector ordering.
Label is UI help text, not a stable binding identifier.
Use In TOP for component boundaries, not as a generic TOP reference mechanism.
Common output settings can silently resize or reformat input data.
key_concepts: In TOP creates a TOP input connector inside a Component.
Component inputs appear on the left side of the component.
Input ordering is based on operator names in alphanumeric order.
Label provides hover/help text for the connector, not a stable connector id.
Common TOP settings can still resize, filter, or reformat data passing through the input.
